result.description:
Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching to feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery. 
This position is available from November 2026 or sooner for suitable candidates with a valid AMSA Near Coastal Marine Engine Driver Grade 2/3 Certification, for a placement for up to 4 years.
Vessel Engineer Duties:
The Employee will be required to perform certain duties as listed below whilst at Sea (offshore) and on the Farm Site (inshore), although this list is not exhaustive it is a generalised overview of duties.
Engineer Duties:
•	Engine Room Watchkeeping 
•	Periodical Engine Servicing
•	Maintain machinery to an Operational capacity
•	Use of Pumping Systems
•	Vessel Slipping and Docking
•	Vessel Maintenance/Repairs 
•	Vessel Crane Operation
•	Refuelling & Bunkering
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Reporting to Vessel Master
•	Maintenance and repairs coordinated with Fleet Manager
•	Forklift operation on-shore only (if Licensed)
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending 
•	Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
Also including Deck Hand duties:
Deckhand Duties:
•	Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master 
•	Forklift operation (only if Licensed from previous deployment on SWP)  onshore only
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Deck Machinery Operation
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Fish Processing and Packing
•	Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending & Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	High Pressure Water Blasting
•	Painting by Hand and/or Spray
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
•	Portable hand tool use

The Employee will be required to perform the following additional duties whilst at Sea for Offshore Operations.
Navigation Watch:
• Keeping Lookout for other Vessels
• Maintaining Vessel Course as per Master’s instructions
• Vessel Log recording
• Watch Handover to next watch keeper
• Reporting to the Master
• Radio frequency monitoring
A Navigational watch can per performed at any time throughout the day or night, they are generally 1.5-2 hours in duration.

Additional Deck Duties:
• Tender vessel operation
• Launch and retrieval of tender
• Fish Sampling/Chumming
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive Manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel Mooring/Berthing
*This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs,.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day.
Offshore Operations:
Tow & Support operations begin in December through to late March. If Quota is exhausted quickly the Offshore Operations will cease before late March.
Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. 

Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Farm work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the applicable hourly Farm rate. Aquaculture Award:(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)(https://calculate.fairwork.gov.au/payguides/fairwork/ma000114/pdf)
OFFSHORE OPERATIONS
An additional contract is put in place alongside original Deckhand Contract to cover the periods Offshore for Tow & Support operations to classify Duties and Remuneration (there is no Award that covers the "At Sea" roles), contract renumeration is calculated from experience and seamanship knowledge.

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.

Position: Industrial Designer
Type: Full-time
Employer: Image Embroidery
Location: Canning Vale WA 6155
Salary: $147,000 p/a
About the Business:
Image Embroidery is a well-established embroidery and promotional products specialist based in Canning Vale, Perth, Western Australia. The company specialises in high-quality custom logo embroidery, digitising, and the production of corporate, sports, casual apparel, headwear, and promotional items. Known for its commitment to excellence, quick turnaround, and outstanding customer service, Image Embroidery operates in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that values creativity, attention to detail, innovation, and teamwork. The business prides itself on delivering cost-effective, high-quality solutions and building strong client relationships through professional and reliable service.
About the Position:
Image Embroidery is seeking a highly motivated Industrial Designer with a strong embroidery design focus to join our team in Canning Vale. The role involves creating and developing custom designs for embroidery and promotional products, managing design processes from concept to production, and working closely with clients, sales, and production teams to deliver high-quality outcomes within tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. This position plays a key role in driving innovation and ensuring design excellence that supports the company’s reputation for superior promotional products.
Key Responsibilities:
Concept visualisation and sketching according to client requirements.
Consult effectively with the sales team and clients about design requirements, product designs, and resolve design concerns to meet agreed outcomes.
Investigate appropriate materials and develop production processes to ensure ability to produce cost-effective products and meet client requirements.
Ensure that timelines are aligned with production schedules and implement cost optimisation initiatives.
Ensure concepts are closely aligned to requirements through the production of detailed plot charts, blue-prints, renderings, and sample designs.
Produce technical drawings and accurately test product designs using models, prototypes, specialist computer software, and computer-aided design (CAD) technology.
Collaborate closely with the production team to resolve any product faults or manufacturing concerns relating to the design, production time, or materials issues.
Collaborate with the sales team, as required, to present designs, samples, and final work to customers for review and evaluation.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Appropriate Industrial Design / Product Design and Development qualifications.
Minimum 10 years’ relevant experience.
Advanced proficiency in CAD software, design rendering tools, and digitising software specific to embroidery and textile applications.
Strong creative and technical design skills with a keen eye for detail and ability to translate client briefs into production-ready designs.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with proven ability to consult with clients and collaborate effectively across sales and production teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while meeting strict deadlines and maintaining high quality standards.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 PERSOL is one of Australia's largest and longest serving recruitment providers. Delivering both quality temporary and permanent options, we specialise in the recruitment of Professional, ICT, Government, STEM, Management and Executive talent. 
 Our Tier 1 Mining Client is looking for an experienced Senior Hydrogeologist to join their Projects Engineering team supporting a portfolio of operating assets and major projects.

  The Role:   
 This is an opportunity to work within a multidisciplinary project environment delivering hydrogeological investigations, groundwater assessments and water management solutions that support mine operations, infrastructure development and future growth projects. 
  Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:     
 
 Lead hydrogeological investigations and groundwater assessments to support project development and operational requirements. 
 Deliver water supply investigations, sustainable yield assessments and groundwater impact studies. 
 Plan and manage drilling programs, including production and monitoring bore installation, aquifer testing and groundwater monitoring activities. 
 Assess groundwater abstraction impacts and groundwater reinjection opportunities. 
 Support the design and optimisation of water supply systems, borefields and wastewater disposal solutions. 
 Analyse and manage hydrogeological datasets and provide technical interpretation and recommendations. 
 Prepare technical reports, specifications and documentation to support regulatory approvals and compliance requirements. 
 Provide technical guidance and support to project engineers, environmental teams, consultants and contractors. 
 Contribute to permitting, licensing and approvals processes across relevant jurisdictions. 
 
  Required Experience:   
 
 Degree qualified in Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science or a related discipline. 
 Minimum 8 years' experience in hydrogeology and/or water resource management. 
 Strong experience delivering hydrogeological investigations and groundwater assessments within mining, energy, infrastructure or consulting environments. 
 Experience managing drilling programs, aquifer testing and groundwater monitoring activities. 
 Proficiency with GIS software is essential. 
 Experience with groundwater modelling software such as MODFLOW, Leapfrog or equivalent will be highly regarded. 
 Excellent technical reporting and communication skills. 
 Knowledge of Australian water licensing, permitting and regulatory frameworks is advantageous. 
 Full Australian working rights are required.

The Role

Reporting to the Business Unit Manager and the Head of Brand, you will be the hands-on engine room of our marketing function, working across all three equipment categories at once. This is an on-site role at our Deception Bay headquarters, not remote or hybrid.

Your Responsibilities

-  Develop and help implement marketing plans and campaigns across our fuel storage, pavement and painting and decorating ranges.

-  Produce written, image and short-form video content for products across the full range.

-  Build, schedule and report on email campaigns and automated flows in Klaviyo.

-  Assist with the build, monitoring and optimisation of Meta and Google paid campaigns, including pixel-based audiences and conversion tracking.

-  Plan and maintain the social media content calendar across our channels.

-  Coordinate influencer and partnership outreach, briefs and deliverables with trade-relevant creators and brand partners.

-  Manage product content, collections, merchandising and on-site accuracy across our Shopify stores.

-  Analyse campaign and market data and report on performance to guide ongoing activity.

Essential Criteria

To be successful you must be able to demonstrate each of the following.

-  Minimum two years of marketing experience, ideally in a trade, industrial or technical-product environment, with product knowledge across one or more of fuel storage and dispensing, pavement and line-marking equipment or painting and decorating equipment. Exposure across more than one of these ranges will be highly regarded.

-  Advanced proficiency with generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for content development, research, workflow optimisation and campaign support.

-  Demonstrated hands-on experience with Shopify, covering product, collection and content management on a live store.

-  Demonstrated hands-on experience with Klaviyo, covering campaign builds, flows and reporting.

-  Demonstrated experience implementing and using Meta Pixel for audience building and conversion tracking.

-  Strong written English and the ability to produce trade-appropriate, segment-neutral copy.

-  A relevant qualification in marketing, communications or business at diploma level or higher, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

-  Eligibility to work full-time, on-site in Deception Bay QLD.

What We Offer

-  A competitive salary with opportunities for growth and progression.

-  A specialist, varied role with direct exposure to senior leadership.

-  A genuine ownership remit across the full marketing stack.

-  Clear opportunities for professional development and career progression as the business grows.

result.description:
Our valued client – Itero, based in Perth WA is seeking highly experienced MECHANICAL FITTERS to join their dedicated team of professionals. The ideal candidate must be reliable, results-driven, self-motivated, and committed to positively contribute to the team environment.

Itero is Australia’s leading expert in projects complicated by height and specialists in complex asset remediation and maintenance solutions operating across multiple sectors.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
The Mechanical Fitter is responsible for delivering safe, high-quality mechanical maintenance, shutdown, project and installation services for Itero Australia's clients across mining, industrial, commercial and infrastructure sectors. The role is based on client sites and supports Itero's commitment to Zero Harm, quality workmanship and exceptional customer service.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Key Responsibilities
Carry out planned, preventative and breakdown maintenance
Install, overhaul and commission pumps, gearboxes, conveyors, crushers, valves, pipework and rotating equipment
Complete precision alignment, bearing replacement and mechanical fault finding
Read and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs and OEM manuals
Assist with shutdowns, construction and capital projects
Complete job documentation, maintenance reports and QA records
Provide outstanding client service and represent Itero professionally
Maintain tools, vehicles and company equipment
Assist Rope Access crews where required
Travel to metropolitan, regional and FIFO sites as required

Health, Safety, Environment & Quality
Work in accordance with Itero Australia's Integrated Management System
Comply with WHS legislation, client requirements and company procedures
Complete Take 5s, SWMS, JHAs, permits and isolations before commencing work
Report hazards, incidents and near misses immediately
Participate in toolbox meetings and continuous improvement initiatives
Promote Itero's Zero Harm culture
Qualifications & Licences

Mandatory
Certificate III in Engineering – Mechanical Trade (or equivalent)
IRATA Rope Access Level 2/3
Working at Heights
Confined Space Entry
Gas Test Atmospheres
Current Australian Driver's Licence
Construction White Card
Ability to pass medical and drug & alcohol screening

Preferred
High Risk Work Licence (Forklift, EWP, Rigging or Dogging)
First Aid
National Police Clearance (where required by clients)

Skills & Experience
Minimum 3 years’ experience
Experience within mining, industrial maintenance, oil & gas or manufacturing
Strong knowledge of rotating equipment and mechanical systems
Competent with precision measuring equipment and laser alignment
Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams
Excellent communication and commitment to quality

Core Values
Safety First
Integrity
Teamwork
Quality
Continuous Improvement
Customer Focus

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Position: Head Chef
Type: Full-time
Employer: The Yarra Hotel
Location: Abbotsford VIC 3067
Salary: $80,000 – $85,000 p/a
About the Business:
The Yarra Hotel is a long-established and much-loved hospitality venue in the heart of Abbotsford, operating since 1855 as a traditional Australian pub, bar, restaurant and live entertainment space. Offering classic and hearty pub-style meals, weekly food specials, a fully licensed bar, large beer garden, function spaces and regular live music, trivia and community events, the hotel serves locals, visitors and groups seeking a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. With a strong reputation as an Abbotsford institution just a stone’s throw from Victoria Park, the venue values quality food, genuine hospitality, community connection and a positive, team-oriented workplace culture.
About the Position:
The Head Chef role is central to the daily success of The Yarra Hotel’s food offering. You will take ownership of the commercial kitchen, leading menu planning, food quality, cost control and kitchen operations to deliver consistent, high-standard pub meals and specials that meet the expectations of our diverse patrons while supporting the smooth running of the wider venue.
Key Responsibilities:
Planning and designing menus for the hotel
Calculating costs and liaising with suppliers
Directing kitchen operations and managing kitchen staff
Overseeing food preparation, cooking and cleaning processes
Delegating tasks and resolving issues as they arise
Ensuring compliance with hygiene and health and safety regulations
Liaising with the general manager to ensure operations run smoothly
Ensuring all ingredients are fresh and meet quality standards
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply
Certificate III or IV in Commercial Cookery (or equivalent qualification); Food Safety Supervisor Certificate preferred; knowledge of HACCP and food hygiene standards
Minimum 1 year experience working in a commercial kitchen as a chef
Strong technical cooking skills, ability to manage kitchen workflow under pressure, effective leadership and communication skills, attention to quality and cost control, and a collaborative, solutions-focused approach
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
